body.name: singularity-safe Anderson--Rubin inversion
body.construction:
For a fixed deterministic calibration constant \(t_{\alpha_0}\), consider the set
\[
 \left\{b\in[-B,B]:
 \max_{d+2\leq k\leq R_{\max}}
 \left\lVert\widehat Q(\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k)\right\rVert_2
 \leq \frac{t_{\alpha_0}}{\sqrt n}\right\}.
\]
If every environment has at least \(R_{\max}\) observations, define \(\mathcal C_n\) to be this set when it is nonempty and define \(\mathcal C_n=\{\widehat\beta\}\) when it is empty.  If some environment has fewer than \(R_{\max}\) observations, define \(\mathcal C_n=[-B,B]\).
